verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Brex's Team API can manage users, locations, and departments, and Brex offers spend limits and approval flows. Neither is the same as defining granular user roles and permissions. No evidence documents role definitions or permission scoping across team members, locations, or departments, so this adjacent material earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments
